title: CASp Knowledge Database
purpose: Maintain and refine the CASp knowledge/topic coverage map. Existing test-bank question JSON files remain the source of question content; this database stores only topic structure and source-file/question-ID links.
important_limitations: This is a study aid, not legal advice or a substitute for the adopted California Building Code, statutes, regulations, ADA standards, or agency guidance.

The imported notes and topic links may contain unverified or conflicting claims. Verify jurisdiction, project facts, adopted edition, and controlling source before relying on any legal or technical conclusion.
Question text, choices, answers, and explanations are not copied into this file. The test-bank JSON files remain the source of truth; knowledge nodes link to their source file and question IDs.
Questions may be edited, moved, or culled independently. Reconcile topic links against the test-bank files after bank changes.

mind_map_editing.node_flags: Set important=true on a topic or subtopic to flag it in the mind map.
mind_map_editing.custom_nodes: New nodes are user-added and start with no question links.
mind_map_editing.removal_behavior: Removing a mind-map node removes it from taxonomy only; test-question source records are preserved.
mind_map_editing.note: The taxonomy tree is the topic-coverage model. It can be expanded independently of question content and curation.
mind_map_editing.link_model: question knowledge_node_ids contain the full path; leaf topic nodes link back to source file paths and question IDs; parent coverage is derived recursively
